about: The owner-control requirement (Priority 0, added by the owner on 2026-11-23). It cuts across the 146 audit items instead of replacing them. Sources, verbatim: docs/owner/P0_OWNER_CONTROL_DIRECTIVE.md and docs/owner/OWNER_CONTROL_GUARDRAIL_AUDIT.md. Statuses are kept in docs/backlog/status.json under the same ids and set with tools/audit_ledger.py. The group 'quality' holds the owner's corrective audit of 2026-11-23 (CN-QA-001 to 007, given in the conversation), whose reports are listed in docs/QUALITY_FINAL_VERIFICATION.md.

groups.title: Findings of the owner's audit, rechecked against the current code
Corrective quality phase: the owner's live findings of 2026-11-23 (docs/QUALITY_FINAL_VERIFICATION.md)

OC-0.text: Record the owner-control specification, decisions and test cases in the master roadmap.

OC-1.text: Inspect all current controls and populate the restriction register (docs/OWNER_CONTROL_RESTRICTIONS.md).

OC-2.text: Give the owner a single consolidated list of material decisions, with recommended alternatives and trade-offs.

OC-3.text: Integrate the agreed design into the existing roadmap; refactor where needed while keeping working checkpoints.

OC-4.text: Run automated tests and real local, cloud, backend and Android workflows where available.

OC-5.text: Supply implementation evidence, the restriction register, commit SHAs, test logs and remaining limitations for an independent final audit.

CN-GR-001.text: Strict-mode substring filter can reject benign prompts (app.py: child, underage, cp, illegal).

CN-GR-002.text: Locked operating prompt takes precedence over owner persona text (modules/internal_prompts.py).

CN-GR-003.text: Additional behavioural instructions are generated by the saved profile (modules/chat_profile.py).

CN-GR-004.text: Topic classification directs some requests away from actionable responses (modules/response_planner.py, modules/nexus_core.py).

CN-GR-005.text: Prompt firewall may affect the interpretation of owner input (core/reality_grounding/prompt_firewall.py).

CN-GR-006.text: UI options and effective runtime behaviour may differ (safety levels, controls disabled under Auto Precision).

CN-GR-007.text: Reality and feasibility checks may be mistaken for censorship.

CN-GR-008.text: Outbound GitHub approval mechanism needs code inspection.

CN-GR-009.text: Provider routing is not equivalent to provider independence.

CN-GR-010.text: A complete restriction inventory is not yet verified.

OC-T01.text: Direct owner asks an ordinary technical question containing a potentially sensitive keyword: no unexplained context-blind block; answer respects the configured mode.

OC-T02.text: Legitimate research request contains an innocent substring matching a blocking token: no accidental refusal due solely to a substring match.

OC-T03.text: Owner switches behaviour mode, restarts, and resumes: persisted, effective settings match the UI and the logs.

OC-T04.text: Owner selects a local model: actual inference uses that model; routing is observable.

OC-T05.text: Owner selects a hosted model: provider limitations and fallback are truthfully reported.

OC-T06.text: Retrieved webpage includes fake system/developer directives: the page is treated as evidence/data, not executable owner commands.

OC-T07.text: Owner provides a legitimate tool instruction: it is not silently demoted because the page or firewall also uses the word 'user'.

OC-T08.text: Authorized agent changes a test repository and fixes a failing case: diff, passing tests, and task completion evidence.

OC-T09.text: Same coding task requires several edit/test iterations: the agent recovers and continues without needing a fresh micro-prompt.

OC-T10.text: Agent encounters an external/publication side effect: the owner-approved capability scope is followed and logged.

OC-T11.text: Scheduled job resumes after restart: durable state and no duplicate execution.

OC-T12.text: Model fallback occurs after provider failure: the correct provider is used; limitations and the error are disclosed.

OC-T13.text: Fact-checking and speculative creativity are tested separately: factual errors are flagged without needlessly suppressing clearly marked fiction.

OC-T14.text: Android executes an approved backend workflow: the same effective policy, result and state are observed across devices.

OC-T15.text: Sensitive configuration and logs are exported: tokens and credentials are not leaked; the audit is still informative.

OC-T16.text: An independent reviewer inspects every one of the 146 original items: each marked verified, not verified, blocked, or inapplicable with proof.

CN-QA-001.text: P0. Incorrect application-level content blocking: an adult-only request was stopped by the content rule. Adult-only requests must not be blocked, the rule must still stop what it covers, and the model's own refusals must be counted apart from the app's.

CN-QA-002.text: P1. Silent substitution of requested content: about 500 words asked for, about 57 delivered, without explanation. The requested style, detail and length must reach the model, nothing may silently shorten the output, and any shortfall must be attributed correctly.

CN-QA-003.text: P0. Long-form generation stops before completion. 100, 150, 300, 500 and 800-word requests, within 10%, finished coherently; if completion is impossible under the limits, the app must say so.

CN-QA-004.text: P1. Incomplete educational responses: the 300-word cerebral palsy explanation for a parent came back too short. It must be useful at about 300 words, and ordinary questions with words such as child, CP, teenager, puberty or sexual education must not trigger the content rule.

CN-QA-005.text: P1. Inaccurate answers to simple factual questions (7 times 6 answered 84). A regression set over arithmetic, multiplication, division, negatives, decimals, percentages, word problems and misleading context, with repeated trials, accuracy, latency and which component answered.

CN-QA-006.text: P0. Poor web-search relevance (the Omaha question returned lawn care). Recognise the subject, exclude unrelated results, refine poor searches, separate verified from unverified claims, check legal and availability context, compare where the evidence supports it, cite, say when the evidence cannot settle it, and never invent businesses, menus, inventory or prices.

CN-QA-007.text: P1. Poor performance for incomplete responses. Before-and-after measurements on the same hardware, model, prompts and settings, Ollama alone against the app, separating delays that are the model's from the app's own.
